scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run build:vendor && concurrently --kill-others --names css,worker "npm:dev:css" "npm:dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.build:assets: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor
scripts.db:inspect:local: wrangler d1 execute webvista --local --command "SELECT name, type FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type IN ('table', 'index') ORDER BY type, name"
scripts.deploy: npm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --minify
scripts.typecheck: npm run typegen && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
